summary: Re-audit of the re-synced input (sha256 10FDAD43622F19BAC8CD4C72B94908033831F995CF828D0567078CA4A524984B, 136306 bytes, 50 changed files) after the platform AI-review fixes. All requested fixes verified in the file contents: patch 0016 now declares `napi_value values[5];` with writes/reads 0..4, `curtain_rect rect = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0};`, `curtain_core_get_rect` only under `if (g_core)`, an early `if (!g_core)` null return in `GetPixels`, and guarded 0-default width/height in `ScreenSize`; patch 0013 no longer contains `expect_double` and still yields exactly 28 assertions (22 expect_int + 6 expect_rect call sites). No regressions: all 34 patches are still pure additions with `--- /dev/null` headers, no binary content, no `#ifdef __OHOS__`/injected `-D` macros, no dangerous functions (only a bounds-checked memcpy), and the earlier P1 credential leak remains fixed (patch 0008 has `"signingConfigs": []`; a deep scan of all 50 file_contents found no real credential blobs, no `.ohos`/`C:\Users` absolute paths, no tokens — the only keyword hits are quoted prose in the committed previous audit result and the feedback retrospective). Deception checks R34/R9/R8/R19/R40/R51 remain satisfied (real packaged `curtain_check` 28 assertions executed via build()'s cmake.test() and test_package's 16-assertion test.sh; substantive ArkUI/NAPI/C-core adaptation; upstream N=0 true), the conandata URL is the official HTTPS archive with sha256 re-confirmed against the downloaded tarball (a361bf9e...43950adb), MANIFEST assertion_count is 16, the feedback report has no unfilled placeholders and its 34-patch/path A/E429 claims match the archive, test-report no longer contains the stale '36 patches' or pending-verification text, manifest.yaml was regenerated for the resync (source_work_hash 338c9bb2..., generated_at 16:26:39, patches_count 34), R26/R32/R33/R37/R38, PF7/PF8/PF9 and W2 atomicity (only archives/c/curtain/**, feedback/**, knowledge/drafts/**) all pass, and the L4 `targets`/`gets` hits remain the known benign false positive. The bot's claim that the PR diff contains only 15 of the 34 patches is a display/diff-cache artifact: this input lists all 34 patch files among the 50 changed files (34 = 34 declared in conandata), though the input's diff_stat metadata still lags the file_contents for the amended patches 0013/0016 and notes.md, so the pushed PR diff should be refreshed/confirmed. Remaining non-blocking findings: quality-report.md still says 9 patches (P2), plus P3 advisories on the committed stale audit-result.json, test-report hilog traceability, test.sh safety/output style, tarball-URL homepage in MANIFEST.yml/commands.json, and the duplicated notes.md footer. Verdict: pass (0 P0, 0 P1; 1 P2, 5 P3).
